content.text: Digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-keeps-2|COREMERCH guide to creators]] in regions facing payment platform restrictions often struggle to set up effective online stores. Whether you're based in Nigeria, Zimbabwe, or any other area where conventional services like Stripe or PayPal are unavailable, building a crypto store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-15|cloudflare]] Pages provides a sovereign solution. This guide walks you through the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-3|The Full]] needed to deploy your store quickly and effectively using Stack 02, leveraging Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure of Cloudflare Pages combined with Workers and Supabase provides a robust foundation for your crypto store. Unlike traditional payment platforms, this setup allows you to bypass reliance on external services that might restrict access or impose fees. By utilizing NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring that your revenue stream remains reliable in environments where currency volatility is a concern. This architecture is designed to offer you full ownership and control, eliminating dependencies that can jeopardize your business.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your store, ensure you have a GitHub account for hosting your site and a Cloudflare account to manage your domain. You will also need to create a Supabase account to handle your database and backend logic. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as it will be crucial for integrating your payment system. Additionally, gather your digital products, such as ebooks or templates, as you'll be uploading these to your store. Ensure your crypto wallet is set up to receive payments.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring your Cloudflare Pages to host your website. Use the Supabase dashboard to create a database for storing order data. Implement Cloudflare Workers to manage backend logic and handle requests between your site and Supabase. Integrate NOWPayments to facilitate crypto transactions, ensuring that webhook notifications are set for immediate payment confirmation. Test the functionality rigorously on the mainnet to ensure that payments process without issues and your products are delivered seamlessly upon confirmation.
Infrastructure sovereignty means you own your store and data completely.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once the setup is complete and tested, it’s time to launch your store. Promote your store URL, making sure it’s accessible to potential customers. Direct them to your site where they can browse and purchase your digital products using crypto. Monitor the first transactions closely to ensure everything functions correctly. After initial sales, assess your transaction flow and customer feedback to identify any adjustments needed to improve user experience and operational efficiency.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is live and processing transactions smoothly, consider scaling your operations. You can expand your product offerings or explore additional marketing strategies to reach a broader audience. Leverage insights from your Supabase database to analyze sales data and customer behavior, allowing you to refine your offerings. Consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for enhanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, ensuring your store remains competitive and secure as you grow.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.

The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create your GitHub and Cloudflare accounts to host your site. Set up a Supabase account for database management. Gather your digital products for upload. Configure Cloudflare Pages for your website. Implement Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Test your payment processing on the mainnet. Launch your store and promote your URL. Monitor initial transactions for any issues. Analyze data for future scaling opportunities.

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script, while Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. Stack 02 provides a more robust infrastructure, deployed in 48 hours with end-to-end testing.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host your digital product store on either platform. GitHub Pages is great for simple sites, while Cloudflare Pages offers enhanced performance and control, especially when using backend services.
Is there a way to automate product delivery?

Absolutely. By integrating your Cloudflare setup with Supabase and NOWPayments, you can automate product delivery immediately after confirming payment, ensuring a seamless experience for your customers.
